slides.notes: Writing A: Part 6 short message, post-diagnostic and unscored. Expect three content points plus greeting and closing. Do not intervene on missed jobs now; count them at conference. Collect the unaided baseline FIRST (5 min, papers down); click Hint only afterwards for the repair pass. Expected misuse: copies both can-or-cannot without deleting one.

slides.task: Mia invited you to her birthday party. Thank her, say if you can come, and say what you will bring. Write 30–50 words.

slides.notes: Writing B: abbreviated Part 7 notes-expansion, post-diagnostic and unscored. Collect the unaided baseline FIRST (5 min, papers down); click Hint only afterwards for the repair pass. running race = the competition in the notes (confirm orally). Expected misuse: It is water / It is running race (noun for feeling word) — offer fun or exciting.

Show me the proving word. Was it a new word? Did you re-read?
slides.notes: Diagnostic conference, ~8 min. Pick three representative errors spanning causes: knowledge (did not know the form), reading (missed the clue), vocabulary (one word blocked meaning), checking (knew it on re-read). Compare baseline and writings on task fulfilment, complete sentences, meaning, spelling and punctuation, and connected ideas. Confirm Strong, Developing or Weak only after the learner explains.
slides.prompt: Pick three answers. What did you choose? Which word proves it?

visual.instruction: Mistakes help us choose the next step.

slides.notes: One-bottleneck repair, ~7 min total with the repair attempt. Default sentence path shown; the teacher chooses one path from the conference evidence instead: missed jobs (count each job to its sentence), blocked word (read before and after it), carelessness (STOP, READ, PROVE), strong baseline (add precise detail). Elicit the learner's decisions; the teacher may scribe but must not author.
slides.prompt: We fix one thing today: full sentences.

visual.instruction: Repair one sentence from your own writing.
